breakdown.description: The prescribed global horizontal point load is projected onto the local normal direction of the skew boundary
breakdown.reason: The Agent failed to fix the inconsistency. The original prompt incorrectly instructed to project the horizontal point load onto the local normal direction. The ground truth corrects this by simply stating to apply the point load as specified. The Agent's generated specification repeated and elaborated on the user's error: 'Resolve the 5 kN horizontal point load at (1.1,0.15) into the component normal to that edge and apply the resulting normal force...'
